mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, plan, status, trial_ends_at, extra_branches FROM tenant_subscriptions WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT tenant_id, plan, status, trial_ends_at, extra_branches FROM tenant_subscriptions
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_subscriptions (tenant_id, plan, status, trial_ends_at, extra_branches, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{plan}, #{status}, #{trialEndsAt}, #{extraBranches}, #{now}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET plan = EXCLUDED.plan, status = EXCLUDED.status, trial_ends_at = EXCLUDED.trial_ends_at, extra_branches = EXCLUDED.extra_branches, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT plan, started_at, ends_at FROM tenant_plan_trials WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY started_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_plan_trials (tenant_id, plan, started_at, ends_at, started_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{plan}, #{startedAt}, #{endsAt}, #{startedBy}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
